newsitem.title: USA: Cycomm CEO sees profitability by year-end.
newsitem.headline: Cycomm CEO sees profitability by year-end.

text.p: Cycomm International Inc's President and CEO, Albert Hawk, said that the company expects revenues in excess of $20 million for the year and profitabity by the end of the year.
Hawk said that during the first quarter ended March 31, the company received $6.4 million worth of orders which will be reflected in third and fourth quarter results.
The company reported a net loss for first quarter of 1997 of $1.2 million on revenues of $3.6 million as compared with a net loss of $2.2 million on revenues of $323,983 in the first quarter of 1996.
Hawk said that "The company, for the first time in its history has a backlog in excess of $7 million and (it) anticipates continued revenue growth in each subsequent quarter."
Cycomm International develops and manufactures a variety of information technology products through its subsidiaries.
